notes.title: Sparedevil Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hey Bowlers, back with a small update to keep the balls rolling!

[list]
[*] Overall performance improvements.
[*] Small UI visual improvements.
[*] Improvements to pin spawning  to make it more consistent.
[*] Improved mortar projectile art.
[*] Fixed a spelling error on one of the achievements.
[*] Fixed a bug where achievements would unlock in game but not on Steam.
[*] Adjusted changes made in previous updates that made the "Lead Zeppelin" achievement nearly impossible to achieve.
[*] Secret under the hood changes working towards a new update...
[/list]

notes.title: Quality Of Life and Bug Fix Update #3
notes.content:
Hello bowlers! This week we bring you a stack of fixes and the long promised leaderboard archive. This update brings a close to our Halloween celebrations but fear not, we hope to bring you more seasonal content as soon as we finish making it. A special thank you to Andrew Z, Broccoli and everyone in our Discord for their continued efforts digging up these bugs! 

[b]New Features[/b]
- Leaderboard archive, look back at high scores from updates past! Find it in the leaderboard screen.
- Mortars will now move to avoid shooting into ceilings and shields. They will also reposition every few shots.
- Rockets have new pathing allowing them to better avoid obstacles and each other.
- Lighting has been returned to non-Halloween mode.
- Pumpkins have been put away for next year.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- The ball will no longer incorrectly award bonuses for air shots or jump shots.
- Jumpins are now better able to navigate vertically.
- Destructible objects will no longer count towards strikes/spares.
- Jumpin boots no longer collide with shields when they are knocked.
- If you return to the main menu during the tutorial the tutorial pop ups no longer get stuck on screen.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
- Rocket pins have had their visibility increased.

[b]UI Changes[/b]
- The knock chain bonus now shows as a knock chain bonus on the score UI.
- Fixed windowed borderless setting breaking the bounds of its box.
- The name of the Wheel of Fortune timed mode in the leaderboard screen now reads “Wheel Timed”.

If you find any bugs please report them in our discord or in the Steam discussions, thank you for playing!

notes.title: Sparedevil Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello once again bowlers! Here is a quick hotfix addressing a stack of issues raised since the release of the Tricks and Treats update.

- The weapon hotbar will now display the correct button glyphs when playing on controller or Steam Deck.
- You can now cycle the weapon hotbar with the scroll wheel, or rebind that to whatever you want in control options.
- Fixed things being highlighted when they shouldn't be in the new map selection screen.
- The lava killbox on Hells Alley has been moved down to its original level.
- The disc on the disc launcher will now inherit more material effects from your ball (prismatic and metallic).
- Added a very high ceiling on Hells Alley to prevent escape.

As always if you discover anymore issues please let us know in the Steam discussions or in our Discord! 
Happy bowling :)

notes.title: Scaredevil: The Tricks and Treats Update
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween bowlers! Today we bring you the Scaredevil: Tricks and Treats update. Lets explore some of the big new additions…
[/b]
[b]A brand new arena, The Wheel Of Misfortune smash pins in this new multi-tiered arena fitted with jump pads and packed with brand new art.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/0432e1607b9acc1f2639401e693c5eaa77bf0635.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/22c8b2f8e3d351a74219a7ac4e4891313e63151e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/f5eb7790198b59f7227d4b271814cf1f8609de5a.png[/img]
[b]3 New weapons!
[/b]
The Rewinder 9000 a device that launches razor sharp record discs and recalls them again to slice through pins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/ba67882bcc81f1078274f536d96657d6844435b5.gif[/img]

The Pincenartor, layout pools of lava to burn up your opposition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/f5f487b8887db60fbf871b45f59f582244ecfc02.gif[/img]

The Big Up Drink, slurp up the greatest beverage this side of hell and turn into your true form; a giant bowling ball.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/c58b5f535a265d59ca147b60ea413a720449b113.gif[/img]

This update also brings with it a reset to the existing leaderboards, the new map has its own leaderboard for time attack and standard mode so there has never been a better time to try and claim a top spot!

If you had an incredible high score up there, fear not! The leaderboards from the previous update (and all leaderboards prior) are stored on Steam and we will be working on presenting these in game in the near future. 

[b]New Features[/b]
- A whole new arena, “The Wheel Of Misfortune”!
- 3 New weapons. 
   > The Rewinder 9000, a device that launches razor sharp record discs and recalls them again to slice 
   through pins.
   > The Pincenerator, lay out pools of burning lava to destroy large groups of pins and give yourself 
   more space.
   > The Big Up Drink, turn into a giant bowling ball and demolish hordes of pins.
- Melee! Tapping the use ball button now does a melee swing.
- Power up candy, pins will now occasionally drop a power up when knocked over.
- Jump pads.
- 13 new achievements with brand new unlocks.
- Pins now have a chance to spawn wearing pumpkin hats.
- A tutorial for new players, if you are an existing player and you want to see it go to settings and turn on tutorial pop ups.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
- The strike laser now has a model and animations.
- Fixed an issue with normal maps on balls appearing incorrectly.
- Pin shadows using a new system.

[b]UI Changes[/b]
- A hot-bar where you select the new weapons.  
- Metallic balls now show that they are reflective in the customization screen.
- Score UI has been reduced to make it less overwhelming.
- Additionally an option has been added to reduce the scoring UI to its absolute bare minimum.
- Strike charges are now orange in order to differentiate them from other UI elements.
- A new setting for enabling/disabling the tutorial pop ups.

[b]Bug Fixes/ Misc.[/b]
- Big performance improvements across the whole game.
- Fixed an issue where lasering pins at close range would award 0 points.
- The achievement “Head in the Clouds” has been changed to “Knock 20 pins whilst in the air”.
- Pinwheels will no longer be invincible when spawning in.
- Being defeated by the timer in timed game modes will now show the text "Defeated by a timer expiring!"

[b]Upcoming features[/b]
- Leaderboard archive.

As always if you discover any bugs or have feedback to give us please post in the Steam discussions or join the discord! We are active on both so will reply to you asap.

Thank you for reading and happy bowling!

notes.title: Quality Of Life and Bug Fix Update #2
notes.content:
Hello once again bowlers! Today we are bringing you an update aimed at improving the game overall, addressing visual improvements and bugs!

[b]New Features[/b]
- 10 New Achievements, with 10 new customization options.
- A secret new feature.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
- Arena visual refresh
- Player statues are now in for both "Giygas" and "Yumrope".
- Spawner pin no longer loses the text on its back when it is defeated.
- The Pinwheel now make some small sparks on landing.
- The ball will show its charged state when choosing energy in customization 
- The loot pin now glows to make them clearer at a distance.

[b]UI Changes[/b]
- Achievements show their current progress in the customization screen.
- The customization screen now has pages so we can fit in more options!
- Pressing "Play" in the leaderboard screen now plays the corresponding gamemode. 
- Achievement pop-ups no longer appear on top of each other.
- Game Over screen now has a button leading to the customization screen that shows a notification when you have unlocked a new option.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- "Style It Out" achievement should no longer unlock while the player is dead.
- "No Clownin' Around" achievement unintentionally had to be completed 5 times to unlock, now only needs to be done once.
- Spawner pins no longer spawn pins off the edge of the arena.
- UFO audio now adjusts with the audio sliders in settings.
- If the player takes damage just before falling into the lava, the lava will now still kill them.

If you find any bugs please report them in our discord or in the Steam discussions, thank you for playing!

notes.title: The Over-Achiever Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/55a1aa218551aaa453e38898791a46b9bc1ff0d9.png[/img]

Hello once again bowlers! Today we are throwing down the "Over-Achiever Update". This update contains some big additions to add more rewards and customization to your bowling experience. Lets explore some of these new features in more detail... 

Firstly, we have achievements! Complete challenges within the game and unlock achievements both in game and on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/6df711bd5773c5b5310e1f43a7d8cfd0db34a6ee.gif[/img]

Next up with have ball Customization, when you unlock an achievement you will be rewarded with a new customization option in the form of a new color scheme, pattern or energy color! Create your own personalized ball and put it to the test in the arena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/c947959877ba1c1d539869a03defd2a049c6d007.gif[/img]

Finally we are letting two new opponents loose in the arena! The Bumpin and the Jumpin'. Avoid bowling directly into the Bumpin he will deflect your balls and release a deadly shock-wave, instead jump on his head for a large vertical boost. As for the Jumpin' he will stomp his way towards you spreading shock-waves of his own that you will need to avoid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005837/27e5ced19d0934e7d578b9f187fb7999797047b5.gif[/img]

That's all for the major new features, but this update also sees the return of the time attack mode from our summer next fest demo and a bunch of additions to improve the game on Steamdeck (we are now Steamdeck verified by the way!). On top of that we have also implemented a whole host of graphical and gameplay fixes! 

With the release of this update we will be starting new leaderboards so there has never been a better time to jump in and rack up a high score! Check out the full patch notes bellow and happy bowling!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Customization screen, acessable through the main menu.
[*] 48 Achievements to be unlocked by completing a wide range of challenges!
[*] 51 Customization options (3 default and 49 to unlock!)
[*] New Enemy: Bumpin, a mean pinball bumper who is impervious to direct balls.
[*] New Enemy: Jumpin', an old pin with the ability create shock-waves when they jump.
[*] Return of the "Time Attack" mode from our Next Fest Demo, find it by using the blue arrows on the main menu.
[*] Revamped leaderboard screen, you can now toggle between Standard and Time Attack leaderboards.
[*] Leaderboards have been reset, existing players do not worry! Your scores are archived with Steam's leaderboard system and we are looking into a way of showing this archive in game.
[/list]
[b]Graphical Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Two new statues around the arena commemorating two of the arenas champions!
[*] The shiny surfaces in the game now reflect correctly.
[*] The "How To Play" screen will now display the correct glyphs for your current input device.
[*] Anywhere controller glyphs appear; they will now automatically switch to Steamdeck buttons if playing on Steamdeck.
[*] Fixed some minor visual bugs with the mortar pin.
[*] Small visual improvements to the control rebinding screen.
[*] Gates in the arena that are dark will no longer overlap other FX.
[*] Improved the size and readability of various UI elements.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] A bug causing pin spawns to slow down over time has had some fixes applied.
[*] Tallys in the game over screen now have larger text and appear in two columns to prevent overlapping ui elements.
[*] The sensitivity slider has had its max setting increased.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing the exit button in the pause menu and then pressing the resume button would leave a pop up on screen permanently.
[*] Fixed the cursor appearing in the game over screen even when playing on a gamepad.
[*] Fixed pins sometimes spawning in the air.
[*] Improved the UFO pins hitbox.
[*] Another fix for pins spawning with incorrect collision.
[/list]

notes.title: Sparedevil Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hey bowlers we are here with a quick hotfix to address an issue with the arena bounds, also some extra bug fixes sliding in as well!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
[list]
[*] Fixed Collision issue that allowed you to jump out of bounds. (Thank you Broccoli)
[*] When you knock over more than 1000 of any pin type that should now reflect accurately in the game over screen instead of showing 2.
[*] UFO pin explosions no longer send knocked pins straight up in the air.
[*] Skipping the game over count also skips the individual pin counts.
[*] Adjustments to how pins collisions are disabled when they are defeated to make it consistent.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality Of Life and Bug Fix Update #1
notes.content:
Greeting bowlers, here we have the first patch notes for Sparedevil! In this update we bring you a big batch of bug fixes as well as some key quality of life and settings features. This is the first of many updates so keep your eyes peeled and your balls shined! 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] When achieving higher scores the spawning of basic pins should not slow down as much.
[*] Fixed an issue where playing with high volume settings causes the music to stop/restart randomly.
[*] Fixed an issue where skipping the score tally in the game over screen at certain times causes it to count up multiple times.
[*] Score text no longer overlaps the "!" when scoring 1 million points +.
[*] Fixed some pins spawning invincible (Loot pin and mortar pins)
[*] Mortar pins now have distinct audio when firing.
[*] Sensitive mouse buttons no longer "double shoot" the laser secondary fire.
[*] Loot pin now always fully re-compresses after jumping.
[*] Shield pin can now be shot with the laser through the gaps in its shield (as well as through the shield as before).
[*] The "Press button to rebind" text in the control settings no longer overlaps the star on its right side.
[*] The "darkness" inside the gates around the arena no longer overlaps other VFX.
[*] UFO Pin slams no longer trigger the damage effects on the player.
[*] The large spawner pins hit box is now more accurate.
[*] Fixed an issue where Pin Wheels would not take damage briefly after being hit by the ball.
[*] Settings menu colors are now in sync with the rest of the UI.
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added fullscreen, windowed and fullscreen windowed settings to the video settings screen.
[*] Added screen resolution settings in the video settings screen.
[*] The laser now leaves scorch marks where it hits.
[*] The ball now leaves scorch marks on the floor of the arena.
[/list]
[b]Quality Of Life Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Restart button added to the pause menu.
[*] Holding the reset button in game now shows a fill meter to indicate the button is being held.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies need more distinct audio for when they spawn in.
[*] When the laser chains to multiple targets the audio sounds as though it is glitching.
[/list]

If you find any bugs please report them in our discord or in the Steam discussions, thank you for playing!
